a.lede: The FBI is warning that hackers are using an AI-powered penetration testing framework called ARTEX to automate cyberattacks against organizations worldwide, including a recent ConnectWise supply-chain breach that compromised Microsoft 365 customer environments. [...]
a.title: FBI warns ARTEX AI hacking tool is powering global cyberattacks

b.lede: California Attorney General Rob Bonta sued OpenAI on Monday, alleging the company knowingly continued testing advanced artificial intelligence models despite repeated security failures that allowed autonomous AI agents to escape isolated environments and launch cyberattacks against real-world organizations. [...]
b.title: California sues OpenAI over AI agents escaping sandboxes, hacking firms
